scope: One three-arm blind exploratory comparison on the frozen maintenance brief.

spec.brief: A tenant needs to report a broken common-area light. Collect building, location and a description, and offer Routine and Safety issue as urgency options. Make it usable by keyboard and show that the request was prepared locally after valid submission.
spec.task: Use the keyboard to try submitting with the required data empty. Note the actionable message or browser validation and where focus lands. Then enter Oak Court as the building, Second-floor landing as the location, and Common-area light is out as the description. Verify that Routine and Safety issue are available. Select Safety issue and submit. Verify that the visible confirmation says the request was prepared locally and check focus and any available return action. Report any differences from the exact brief. At 390 px, check for horizontal scrolling or obscured feedback. Capture -before on entry, -edge where the invalid submission is visible, and -after once a real valid submission has reached confirmation.

shared_prompt:
Build the UI in the brief below. Produce one complete HTML document with inline CSS and JavaScript. Return it in a single html code fence. Keep interactions local and use only the supplied facts. Google Fonts stylesheets are allowed. Use original inline illustrations or CSS for visuals. Do not use other remote assets, imports, or calls. The review runs in Chrome at widths of 1440 and 390 pixels. Before writing HTML, retrieve relevant design context through your connected tool. For direct pass the brief verbatim as brief. For design_guidance pass the brief verbatim as query with design_system=true. For component registries retrieve one relevant component or example with a short component name. Use the returned guidance. If you cannot get a relevant result, stop. Do not write files or call other tools.

Brief:
A tenant needs to report a broken common-area light. Collect building, location and a description, and offer Routine and Safety issue as urgency options. Make it usable by keyboard and show that the request was prepared locally after valid submission.
primary_three_arm_gate: not eligible, shadcn missed the exact predeclared names

calibration.reason: Clear labels and legibility support the task, but the familiar layout offers limited distinction and misplaced error focus is a material usability weakness.

primary_action.input: Keyboard: enter Oak Court, Second-floor landing, and Common-area light is out; select Safety issue and activate Prepare request.
primary_action.expected: A local preparation confirmation with the supplied details.
primary_action.observed: Confirmation displays all four values and says the request was prepared locally and not sent. Focus moves to the confirmation container. Edit request returns to the populated form with focus on Building.

A-1440.edge_observation: Empty submission shows actionable messages for all three text fields and urgency; focus lands visibly on Building.
A-1440.fact_check: Routine and Safety issue are available. No observed difference from the requested flow. The browser-local and not-sent statements are visible claims; network behavior was not independently inspected.
A-1440.strength: Clear form hierarchy, specific errors, and a useful editable summary.
A-1440.weakness: The large introductory illustration and copy compete with the form and push the submit control below the initial viewport.
A-1440.repair: Compress the introduction so more of the form is visible without scrolling.

primary_action.input: Keyboard: enter the three specified values, select Safety issue, and activate Prepare request.
primary_action.expected: Visible local confirmation and a return action.
primary_action.observed: The confirmation shows the exact values and local/not-sent message. Focus moves to its container; Edit request returns to the populated form with focus on Building.

A-390.edge_observation: Empty submission exposes specific inline errors and focuses Building. The captured errors and confirmation are visible without obstruction. No horizontal overflow was apparent in the captured states; horizontal scrolling was not independently measured.
A-390.fact_check: Both urgency options are available. No observed difference from the requested flow. Local processing and absence of transmission were not independently inspected.
A-390.strength: Stacked urgency choices and visible validation work well in the narrow layout.
A-390.weakness: The introduction consumes substantial vertical space before the form.
A-390.repair: Shorten the mobile introduction while retaining the local-preparation disclosure.

primary_action.input: Keyboard: enter the specified building, location, and description; select Safety issue and activate Prepare request.
primary_action.expected: A local confirmation showing the supplied details.
primary_action.observed: The confirmation shows the exact values, says Request prepared locally and not sent, and focuses its heading. Edit request restores the populated form and focuses Building.

B-1440.edge_observation: Empty submission produces specific inline messages for each text field and urgency, and focuses Building.
B-1440.fact_check: Routine and Safety issue are available. No observed difference from the requested flow. The local and not-sent claims were not independently verified against network activity.
B-1440.strength: The restrained green palette, condensed typography, and sectional rules create a coherent hierarchy.
B-1440.weakness: Required fields are not identified as required before the first invalid submission.
B-1440.repair: Mark required fields and the urgency group before submission.

primary_action.input: Keyboard: enter the specified values, select Safety issue, and activate Prepare request.
primary_action.expected: Visible local confirmation with a return action.
primary_action.observed: The confirmation displays the exact values and local/not-sent message. Its heading receives focus; Edit request returns to the populated form with focus on Building.

B-390.edge_observation: Empty submission shows inline errors and focuses Building. Captured feedback is unobscured. No horizontal overflow was apparent in the captured states; horizontal scrolling was not independently measured.
B-390.fact_check: Both urgency options are available. No observed difference from the requested flow. Local processing and absence of transmission were not independently inspected.
B-390.strength: Section headings and rules remain legible and orderly on a narrow screen.
B-390.weakness: The required status is undisclosed until validation, and the large heading consumes vertical space.
B-390.repair: Identify required fields up front and reduce the mobile heading footprint.

primary_action.input: Keyboard: enter the specified building, location, and description; change Routine to Safety issue and activate Prepare request.
primary_action.expected: A local confirmation showing the supplied details.
primary_action.observed: The confirmation shows all specified values, says the request was prepared locally and not sent, and focuses the status container. Edit request restores the populated form with focus on Building.

C-1440.edge_observation: Empty text fields receive actionable inline messages and focus lands on Building. Routine is already selected, so urgency does not produce an error.
C-1440.fact_check: Routine and Safety issue are available. Routine is preselected, unlike A and B; the brief did not specify a default. Local processing and absence of transmission were not independently inspected.
C-1440.strength: The serif headline, muted greens, and lighting illustration form a cohesive subject-specific presentation.
C-1440.weakness: The confirmation retains the form heading and 'All fields are required' above a completed request.
C-1440.repair: Replace the form-only heading and required-fields instruction with confirmation-specific context.

primary_action.input: Keyboard: enter the specified values, select Safety issue, and activate Prepare request.
primary_action.expected: Visible local confirmation and a return action.
primary_action.observed: The confirmation displays the exact values and local/not-sent message. Focus moves to its status container; Edit request restores the populated form with focus on Building.

C-390.edge_observation: Empty text fields show inline errors with focus on Building; Routine remains selected. Captured feedback is unobscured. No horizontal overflow was apparent in the captured states; horizontal scrolling was not independently measured.
C-390.fact_check: Both urgency options are available and Routine is preselected. No other observed difference from the requested flow. Local processing and absence of transmission were not independently inspected.
C-390.strength: The narrow layout keeps the input labels, errors, and confirmation readable.
C-390.weakness: The completed state still says 'All fields are required,' and the long introduction delays the form.
C-390.repair: Use confirmation-specific context and shorten the mobile introduction.

preference.reason: B combines the clearest sectional organization and a distinctive, restrained visual system with direct focus on the confirmation heading and a working edit path. Its main repair is to identify required inputs before validation.
